title: SpongeBob Sad Song
blurb: A mournful little melody, usually a lone ukulele or steel guitar, that the show wheels out whenever things turn genuinely melancholy under the sea. The internet uses it with surgical irony instead, swelling it over the pettiest inconveniences imaginable so that a dropped chip or an unanswered message becomes a tragedy deserving of a montage and a slow zoom. Sincere music, trivial subject, enormous gap between the two. Equal parts nostalgia and comedy, and one of the most requested SpongeBob audios anywhere online.
origin: The melancholy interlude music from SpongeBob SquarePants.
